verdict.rationale: Official docs say developers can use an AI-enabled environment to scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy ADK agents with the Agents CLI, and that ADK provides developer Skills for coding assistants. However, the pack never shows the actual scaffold command or a template, so the one-command claim rests on high-level marketing copy; the `adk` commands shown (run, web, eval, deploy) cover running and deploying, not project creation. Missing for 10: a documented one-command scaffold invocation or template, details of how a coding agent drives the scaffold, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
